dominant_shape: A pale yellow-white flash becomes an orange fireball rolling up out of its own soot, lobes break off it, a dust skirt rolls along the ground and a brown-grey smoke column keeps climbing after the fire is gone.

beats.name: flash
beats.expect: A pale yellow-white flash and a ground shock ring

beats.name: fireball
beats.expect: An orange fireball rolls up out of dark soot; lobes break off it

beats.name: smoke
beats.expect: The fire has gone dark red inside brown-grey smoke; dust rolls along the ground

beats.name: column
beats.expect: A smoke column keeps climbing over the target; debris has landed

beats.name: exit
beats.expect: The column is still climbing and widening as it thins out

acceptance: Colours match a daylight photograph: no pure white body, no saturated red-pink, soot is warm near black
Smoke outlasts the fire and keeps moving up
Smoke meets the ground without a hard horizontal edge
avoid: A glowing ball that only scales and fades
Smoke cut off by a straight line at the floor
